We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.
• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.

• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate Chocolate – Full-Time - Immediate Start - Bruges
jobs.description:
As a sales associate, you are the first point of contact for customers in an exclusive chocolate and delicatessen store in the heart of Bruges. Your warm welcome and professional advice make all the difference for every visitor. You ensure an attractive store, smooth operations behind the scenes, and a top experience for international guests.

On a typical day, you start by receiving deliveries and restocking the store. You greet customers, explain the product range, and respond to their needs. You keep the store tidy, monitor stock, and work closely with colleagues to smoothly handle busy periods. During holiday seasons, you may close up later, but you always enjoy a varied and rewarding workday.

Would you like to be part of a team that values quality, service, and experience? Apply now and turn your passion for chocolate into your profession!

• You have a well-groomed appearance and radiate enthusiasm

Key hard skills:

• Dutch – spoken and written

• English – spoken and written

Sentea is growing, and we are looking for a 
Senior Embedded Software Engineer  to strengthen our team.
 

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will shape the software behind our silicon photonics-based fiber sensor read-out systems. You will work across the complete software stack: from defining the overall architecture to embedded C/C++ on Linux and FPGA firmware, through to network interfaces and Python APIs, and the implementation and validation of our signal processing algorithms.
 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who enjoys owning a system end to end, works closely with the hardware team, and takes pride in building robust, well-tested software that runs reliably in the field.
 

What will you do?
 

Your role:
 
 

• Define the software architecture of our fiber sensor read-out systems 

• Implement and validate the embedded software and signal-processing algorithms 

• Work closely with the hardware and photonics teams  

Who are we looking for?
 

Ideally, you have:
 
 

• At least 5 years of experience in software development. 

• Strong software engineering practices (version control systems, CI/CD, TDD) 

• Experience programming embedded systems in C/C++ 

• Experience with FPGA design (Verilog, VHDL, HLS, Vivado) 

• Experience with embedded Linux 

• Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP) and web protocols 

• Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g. Modbus, PROFINET, MQTT, …) is a plus 

• Experience developing APIs in Python 

• Affinity with hardware: you understand electronic circuits and enjoy working with the hardware team 

• Able to work independently 

• Experience with Agile development and project management is a plus 

• Languages: English, Dutch is a plus 

• Willing to work from our office in Zwijnaarde  

What we offer
 

At Sentea, you will work in a growing deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technology based on silicon photonics.
 

You will have the opportunity to shape the software of cutting-edge photonic read-out systems and help turn advanced technology into reliable products. As part of a small, multidisciplinary team, you will have a varied role covering software architecture, embedded development, algorithms and validation, working closely with photonics and hardware engineers from concept to field deployment.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you fascinated by numbers and looking for a broad accounting role in an international environment (shared service center)? Do you want to expand your knowledge and gradually grow in your responsibilities? Then this opportunity might be just right for you!
 

For an international organization active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a motivated Accountant to strengthen the finance team.
 

Role

Your responsibilities include, among other things:

• You help prepare and consolidate the quarterly figures.

• You support the preparation of periodic financial reporting.

jobs.occupation: Coordinator Internal Sales | Brecht | Vast Contract
jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage. 
 
• You can depend on your own transportation, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.

For a leading utilities client in Brussels, we are looking for an experienced EndPoint Engineer to strengthen the EndPoint Management team. This position offers the opportunity to work in a complex enterprise environment while contributing to the ongoing modernization of the workplace ecosystem.

You will be involved in both operational and project-based activities, supporting a fleet of approximately 2,500 endpoints serving 1,500 users. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical issues while also helping organizations transition towards modern EndPoint management and cloud-based solutions.
Your responsibilities

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex Windows EndPoint incidents and service requests

• Support SCCM/MECM operations including software packaging, deployments, patch management and Windows image maintenance

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency

• Contribute to modern workplace initiatives involving Intune, Autopilot, Entra ID and Conditional Access

• Assist with staging, deployment and lifecycle management activities across the EndPoint landscape

• Share knowledge with colleagues and actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

• 3+ years of experience in Windows EndPoint Management

• Strong troubleshooting skills within Microsoft Windows environments

• Hands-on experience with SCCM / MECM

• Strong PowerShell scripting capabilities

• Experience with, or a strong interest in, Intune, Autopilot and Entra ID

• Knowledge of VDI environments is considered a plus

• Fluent in Dutch, French and English

Computer Futures is a Staffing and Recruitment firm for IT roles in Belgium.

Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators. 
 

Our capabilities cover the main aircraft types, including Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, regional and military aircraft and rotor aircraft. With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. SABCA offers a full range of services to the civil, space and military aviation markets and recently expanded into the commercial Unmanned Autonomous Systems market as an integrator of aerospace-grade solutions for the industry. 
 

Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?
 

Your Main Responsibilities:
 

Reporting to the Head of Engine Services, you will be required to perform the following: 
 
 

• Engine Incoming Inspection 

• Engine Storage, Humidity Checks and Humidity Corrections 

• Engine Preservation 

• Engine Boroscope inspection 

• Engine Boroblending  

• Engine handling, QEC removal and installation

• Engine Identification Plug TST/REP iaw C-rating 

• Replacement of external engine parts 

• Maintain and operate ES tooling 

• Maintain and follow-up of local products 
 

• Full understanding of ATA 100 system and working knowledge of interactions between AMM, ESM, CMM 

• Capability of reading, understanding and implementation of service bulletins and airworthy documentation 

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level
